articleMetrics.title: The 60-bps bleed: shrimp margin loss from RFQ to PO — Ubik Trade Notes
articleMetrics.h1: The 60-bps bleed: anatomy of margin loss in a seafood RFQ-to-PO cycle
articleMetrics.finalTakeaway: Close the file with the controls attached: quote clock, free time, deglazed weight, remedy reserve, and tenor.
figcaptions: A shipment-level view of the same leak: quote validity, detention, deglazed weight, remedy reserve, and finance timing are the five controls that decide whether the file closes clean.
Deglazed economics are the house standard: count, glaze, moisture, and arrival sample evidence all sit on the same operating surface.
